card.name: Numbers inside ranges and years
card.fires_on: The word "to" between two ages in a range, or a digit partway through a year or multi-digit number. It responds where the number is not yet finished or a range end is expected.

modes.label: Age range "to"
modes.description: The word "to" linking two ages in pediatric age groups.

modes.label: Digit inside a dose number
modes.description: A digit partway through a multi-digit amount before mg/mL or mg/kg.
modes.example: After reconstitution, the oral suspension contains 2<<0>>0 mg/mL MMF.

card.writes: It promotes odd tokens and suppresses dashes and range words like "to", so it suggests the number or range continues without a dash.
card.plain: It marks spots inside a number or age range, such as "1 to 23 months" or a year in brackets.
